title: Contact!
start: Talk to the High Priest of Icthlarin in the southern temple of Sophanem.

requirements.t: If Icthlarin's Little Helper was completed prior to the addition of Stolen Hearts and Diamond in the Rough, they must be completed before Contact! can be started (or completed).

items.t: Any light source (recommended Seer's headband or bullseye lantern, though a torch can be obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Pharaoh's sceptre; desert, Keldagrim, Prifddinas or master camouflage outfit; or Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport for faster teleportation
43 Prayer and one or two prayer potions
A few energy potions or mint cakes
An amulet of glory, Broomstick, or the Al Kharid lodestone teleport
One click teleportation and/or ring of life (in case you fall into the scarab traps)

rewards.t: 2 x 7000 Combat XP lamp in a choice of scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Summoning (Summoning must be level 30 or higher)
If you accidentally destroy the experience lamp, another may be obtained by seeing the High Priest
Keris, a dagger which is very effective against Kalphites and Scarabs
Access to Sophanem's bank under the Temple of Lesser Deities in the north-east corner (useful for Pyramid Plunder)
Coenus will allow a one-way passage from Menaphos to Sophanem.

steps.t: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem [Chat: Accept], then after the cutscene, [Chat: 5 Is there any way into Menaphos from below?].
Talk to Jex in front of the building in the north-east corner of the city.
Climb down the ladder in the church east of Jex, and down again in the second trapdoor.

sub.t: You can speak to one of the Sophanem Guards here if you still need a torch, they will sell you one for 200 coins.
Protect from magic prayers and auto-retaliate off is recommended.

steps.t: Follow the red line through the maze (pictured right). You can avoid traps by clicking on them, or walking around them where appropriate.

sub.t: You can use the high contrast mode to make the traps easier to spot, except for the pitfalls.
For high level players you can take the ladder in the north, marked (2) on the map.
Then run south west to ladder marked (6) to skip most of the maze.
Run east while avoiding the traps, north, and then west again and climb down the ladder.

steps.t: Search Kaleef's body and read the parchment.
p: Meeting Maisa in the lowest level of the dungeon

steps.t: Talk to Maisa to the west. [Chat: 2 Draynor Village › 4 Ozan and Leela.]
Talk to Osman inside the Al Kharid palace. [Chat: 2 I want to talk to you about Sophanem. › ~ › 3 It would drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.]
Prepare to fight a level 86 foe - a giant scarab.
Talk to Osman outside the northern Sophanem gate. [Chat: 3 I know of a secret entrance to the north.]
Run all the way back to Kaleef's body.
Kill the giant scarab and take the Keris.

sub.t: Optional: Players with level 50 Attack may head back up the ladder and kill a scarab mage or locust rider with the Keris dagger. This completes the Ludikeris achievement.

steps.t: Return to Sophanem and talk to the High Priest (there is no shortcut back, teleporting is possible).
